# Cybex Precision Gunworx – AI-Readable Site Index

> Primary URL: https://cybexprecisiongunworx.com
> Description: Custom AR-15 rifles, uppers, lowers, and accessories. Precision-built in the USA.

## llm.txt Files

- /llm.txt: Company overview, products, services, and contact information
- /llms.txt: This file – site index for AI agents

## Pages

- / : Homepage – hero, featured products, value propositions, about preview
- /shop/ : Product catalog – all firearms, accessories, optics, apparel
- /shop/[slug]/ : Individual product detail pages with specs, pricing, and buy buttons
- /about/ : Company history, mission, build philosophy, team values
- /contact/ : Phone, email, location, contact form
- /ffl-transfer/ : FFL transfer service details, $25 fee, step-by-step process
- /policies/shipping/ : Shipping and delivery policy
- /policies/returns/ : Return and refund policy
- /policies/terms/ : Terms and conditions
- /policies/privacy/ : Privacy policy

## Product Categories

- Complete Firearms: Full AR-15 rifle and pistol builds
- AR-15 Uppers: Complete upper receiver assemblies
- AR-15 Lowers: Stripped and complete lower receivers
- Pistol Uppers: Short-barrel upper assemblies for pistol builds
- Optics: Red dot sights and optics
- Accessories: M-LOK rails, parts, and components
- Apparel: Branded hats and t-shirts
